verses.text: For the music director. Of David. Foolish people say to themselves, "There is no God." They are rotten. They do disgusting things. No one does good.
The LORD looks down from heaven on all people to see if anyone understands, if anyone looks for God.
They have all turned away. All of them have become rotten. No one does good, not even one.
Do these evil people know nothing? They eat up my people as if they were eating bread, and they never call on the LORD.
There they are, filled with terror, because God is with those who do right.
You evil people ruin the plans of the poor, but the LORD keeps them safe.
I wish rescue for Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD makes his people successful again, Jacob will celebrate and Israel will be glad.
